notes: One 3U row shot from above at an angle (keystoned and slightly rotated). Measurements were made on a perspective-rectified copy (4 corners: panel row TL 447,1095 / TR 4440,1107 / BL 322,2280 / BR 4490,2360 in original pixels); px_per_hp 48.7 is in that rectified frame (about 46-51 px/HP in the original, varying across the frame). Scale is photo-derived: the sixteen panels sum to exactly 84 HP at 48.7 px/HP, the 5 HP Eowave screw offset (7.5 mm) and panel-height bounds agree, and every Eowave catalog width matched here (TITAN 5, SOMMATEUR 5, MAGNETOSPHERE 10, RAYONNEMENT 5, ZONE B.F 5, EO-310 5, EO-311 3) agrees with the photo, so there are no catalog HP disagreements in this photo. Panels fill HP 0-84 with no gaps; about 1 HP of empty rail (a sliding nut is visible) sits between the logo blank and the right case wall, so row capacity is left null (84 occupied, roughly 85 to the wall). Measured start positions all land within 0.4 HP of an integer except Centre/Titan boundary (7.8) and the 3 HP panels (62.9, 76.2); none is ambiguous. Cables hide the Titan-3/Sommateur seam at the top (read at the bottom rail), the end of the EO-31x title, and part of the first Sommateur title. Commons gives no module list for this photo (description is just 'Eowave_system'), so identities come from panel text only.
